The calories depend on what it is. Plain yogurt would be about 60 kcal per 100 g, or roughly 90 kcal for 150 g. Sour cream would be about 200 kcal per 100 g. Mayonnaise would be far higher, but a 150 g serving of it is unlikely. The glossy, smooth look fits thick yogurt or a creamy dessert.

I'll assume a creamy yogurt and pick a middle value of about 130 kcal.
